Bester Update

By: Busisiwe Gumede | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Carte Blanche sits down with Judge Edwin Cameron to unpack the investigation that exposed the Thabo Bester saga. Also, nee details have emerged of the man whose body was used to fake Thabo Bester’s

Unique Selling Point:
The audacious Thabo Bester prison break, the mystery of the unidentified body in cell 35 and the watchdog with no teeth – as they are uncovered, the details of the recent escape from Mangaung prison continue to shock the public both locally and internationally.

For authorities, the focus has been on rounding up all the suspects and figuring out who had what role in the grand plan. And the biggest question in that regard remains: who did the charred remains wheeled out of cell 35 belong to? What seems to have escaped the spotlight is the fact that before the GroundUp exposé, there was an investigation by an independent body that was instrumental in piecing the bizarre facts together. Despite having almost limitless investigating powers, unfortunately this state organ has no authority to lay charges with law enforcement and initiate criminal investigations. It's core functions are to “facilitate the inspection of correctional centres” and “report on the treatment of inmates in correctional centres and on the treatment of inmates in correctional services.” Such reports are then sent to the Minister of Justice, Correctional Services and the portfolio committee.

This body, tasked with overseeing these investigations, is the Judicial Inspectorate of Correctional Services (JICS), headed by Inspecting Judge Edwin Cameron. At the parliamentary portfolio committee recently, he was at pains to explain the limits to the powers of JICS.



Summary:
The benefit of the previous insert is that some of our speakers, including the hidden inmate, speak extensively and passionately about the issues at Mangaung prison. Those previously unheard parts of the interview are hugely informative. With the judge and DCS brought into the conversation the story is a great opportunity to explore the future possibilities when it comes to the DCS-G4S contract. The question here being: if the department failed to listen and act on the repetitive warnings of JICS, how can the public trust that the department will act accordingly and in its best interests when it comes to the G4S contract? The department has said that it is in talks with its legal department about the contract. We expect the department to take the viewers into its confidence and give the status of thos talks.

Press Release:


Deadly Encounters
It was described as an audacious prison break: the charred remains of an unidentified man lay in the now-infamous cell 35 at the G4S private prison in Mangaung while the man dubbed the “Facebook Rapist” made his escape. In a morbid ruse, his alleged accomplice, Nandipha Magudumana, later claimed the deceased as her customary law husband, Thabo Bester. Eleven months later and Bester, Magudumana and numerous alleged co-conspirators are behind bars. But while police tracked the two fugitives all the way to Tanzania, focus shifted to identifying the body left behind in cell 35. Now identified as Katlego Bereng, a man well-known to one of the accused, details of his brutal murder have shocked his family, leaving them with more questions than answers. 
Producer: Busisiwe Gumede-Chizhanje | Presenter: Claire Mawisa 

Script:


INTRO – On dry, dusty pitches in townships across the country, children harbor dreams of one day playing soccer in front of thousands of adoring fans.
VO – And that was true of a little boy born in the 90’s in Ipopeng just outside Bloemfontein.
MOJABENG RALILATENG – KATLEGO'S AUNT
02:58 - ... He loved soccer and Bloemfontein Celtics was his favorite soccer team. - 03:12
KATLEGO MONYANE – KATLEGO'S COUSIN
17:33 - ... Katlego’s dream was to become a celebrity.
17:47 - ... To be in the media, to be known. - 17:54

VO – But fame on the soccer pitch eluded him… instead, many years later, he became a household name for far more sinister reasons…
BREATHER – dip to black and then to previous Bester insert



UPSOUND – BESTER APRIL 2023 INSERT
INMATE X
“Just after 2am, that’s when we heard an explosion.”
“We could all smell the petrol...”
PAUSE
“We then overheard from the nurses that he is dead.”


VO - That “he” was Thabo Bester - convicted murderer and - for a brief period - the country’s most public fugitive.
BREATHER – dip to black and then to Ipopeng township visuals
KATLEGO MONYANE – KATLEGO'S COUSIN
09:30 - … We saw it on the news. Last year we saw that Bester had escaped.
VO – Thabo Bester, escaped from Bloemfontein’s Mangaung Correctional Centre - a privately-run prison - in May last year. He eluded authorities by faking his death in a fire that engulfed the solitary cell he’d been moved to days before.
(PAUSE)
When investigative journalists exposed the prison break the story exploded into one of the most sensational, most talked about in recent memory.

Bester was re-arrested in Tanzania along with his alleged accomplice, Dr Nandipha Magudumana.

UPSOUND

It's alleged she played a crucial role in his escape - a role that may yet tie her to the morbid events that unfolded in Bester's cell.

And Katlego Monyane and his family were unwittingly drawn into the controversy.
KATLEGO MONYANE – KATLEGO'S COUSIN
10:16 - It was a shock to us. It was almost like a movie. I couldn't even say…like really? It felt like it was a mistake.
VO - In April this year, DNA confirmed that what had become known as “the body in cell 35” - initially believed to be Bester - was Ipopeng's soccer-lover and dreamer, Katlego Bereng -
Mojabeng Rali-lateng’s nephew. …
MOJABENG RALILATENG – KATLEGO'S AUNT
17:15 - …It breaks my heart. I am still coming to terms with it but I am not okay. 17:23.
VO - Thirty-year-old Katlego was reported missing by his family in May 2022, the month of Bester’s escape. It’s claimed he was rushed to hospital after collapsing in a shopping mall.
But, to this day, questions remain about what happened to Katlego after he was taken to hospital and HOW he became the infamous body in cell 35".
BREATHER – to take in emotion
LINK - Katlego grew up a stone’s away from this soccer field that once embodied his dreams. It now lies bare, desolate, reflective of the emptiness that his loved ones are now battling with.
BREATHER – visuals to establish aunt
VO – Katlego was raised by his grandmother and his aunt, Mojabeng, while his parents were away working in Johannesburg.
MOJABENG RALILATENG – KATLEGO'S AUNT
04:05 - He never loved conflict within the family. He always wanted us to get along. Especially, his mom and I.
VO - Though unemployed at the time of his disappearance, Katlego was a loving father of two.
MOJABENG RALILATENG – KATLEGO'S AUNT
07:35 He really loved his children. It hurt him that he couldn’t support them financially, but he had so much love for them.


BREATHER – to establish baby mama
VO – The mother of his 3-year old son says she couldn't have asked for a better father for her child.
KATLEGO'S GIRLFRIEND
00:59 - ... He was just that kind of a person. He even tattooed his name on his arm.
05:24 - He wanted him to be a soccer player. He couldn’t wait for him to teach him how to drive, you know? Things like that. - 05:32


VO – She’s asked us to hide her face because their little son doesn’t yet know he won’t be playing soccer with his father again.
KATLEGO'S GIRLFRIEND
02:26 - ... He saw his father on the television but he didn’t understand what he’s doing there. He will just tell you, ‘that’s my father’ - 02:37
VO – And as if losing Katlego isn’t traumatic enough, the family’s grief is on public display… as details about the elaborate escape continue making headlines.
LINK - Katlego’s family searched for an entire year and still even after the confirmation of his death, they are left with so many questions. Was it really their son that collapsed in town and later died in hospital? And how did his body end up in Mangaung prison?
BREATHER – to establish Katlego's cousin with viz of him at the soccer field
KATLEGO MONYANE – KATLEGO'S COUSIN
09:43 - ... It never crossed my mind, like really, because we were still having hope that Katlego was still out there. We never thought that he would be the one that is there. - 09:49 < cover this whole upsound with the sequence of Katlego at the stadium and continue with sequence over the next VO
VO – now, standing next to their field where they once played soccer as young boys, Katlego can’t quite believe he’ll never again see the cousin with whom he shares a name.
KATLEGO MONYANE – KATLEGO'S COUSIN
11:48 - ... because even now when I think about it I still ask myself what really happened? Why him? What did he do? What was the cause? We heard stories that he died before he got to Bester’s cell 35. But the problem is how did he get there? - 11:57
VO - It’s on that question that someone we spoke to in a previous story may be able to shed some light. We called him Inmate X to protect his safety. He was kept in the same section as Bester, and described a series of strange events leading up to the fire.




VO – He’s convinced the body recovered from Bester's cell was smuggled into the prison in a wooden box.
INMATE X – INTERVIEW – NEW UNUSED BITS

22:20 This wooden kiest was taken from the bakkie to the kitchen and was left inside the kitchen and it was left inside the kitchen, inside the fridge.
BREATHER – to go back to aunt
MOJABENG RALILATENG – KATLEGO'S AUNT
CLAIRE - 28:36 - … Do you know how Katlego died first of all? - 29:34
30:07 - No, They said they found him at Central Park after he collapsed because his sugar was low, and they rushed him to the hospital where he died. But the autopsy states that his cause of death was a head injury. So it’s two stories that don’t make sense.
CLAIRE – 29:57 - In your mind, what do you think happened? - 30:01
30:40 - I think he was assaulted. After he was assaulted, he was taken to the hospital or he was taken to the jail after he died. I don’t know.
VO – Bester and his alleged accomplices, including Dr Nandipha Magudumana and her father, are charged with arson, violation of a body and defeating the ends of justice. They all relate to the discovery of the charred remains we now know to have been Kagtlego - (PAUSE) but something the family were tragically unaware of as they continued their desperate search for more than a year.
BREATHER – to start recalling Katlego's disappearance, intercutting with events in prison at the same time
VO – Katlego was last seen by his grandmother on Easter weekend last year. He'd often spend nights out with friends or his girlfriend, but was never away for more than a week…
MOJABENG RALILATENG – KATLEGO'S AUNT
So when he disappeared for more than a month, that's when we got worried becauseIt’s unlike him. His granny told his mother that it had been a week since disappeared. That’s when we really got worried and questioned his granny in detail and she confirmed that she last saw him on the Monday after Easter.


VO – Back then, Katlego's relatives pushed on with their frantic search, unaware of the drama unfolding at the prison managed by private company, G4S.
There, behind hiigh walls, witnesses tried to connect the dots.




MOJABENG RALILATENG – KATLEGO'S AUNT

I remember when it was his birthday, his mother was crying saying it's his birthday but I don't know where my son is. “When I eat and sleep, is my child doing the same?” Those were the questions that she was asking herself, because she did everything to look for him.
VO – Then, one day, their calls simply stopped going through...
BREATHER
LINK - Convicted murderer and rapist, Thabo Bester, together with his main accomplice, Doctor Nandipha Magudumana, are facing at least 12 charges following their arrest last month. But as it stands they are not charged with the murder of Katlego. This has raised questions about why the charge was withdrawn.
VO - It's not clear why a murder charge was withdrawn".

The murder charge was withdrawn due to insufficient evidence pending further investigation.



BREATHER – transition to court viz
UPSOUND COURT APPEARANCE
VO – On the 3rd of May, the anniversary of Bester's escape, Katlego's family was dealt yet another blow.
VO – A charge of murder against the accused was withdrawn due to insufficient evidence.
BREATHER – transition to speaker interview
KATLEGO MONYANE – KATLEGO'S COUSIN
10:52 - We have a lot of questions that we don't get answers to, so it’s a trauma.. - 10:59
MOJABENG RALILATENG – KATLEGO'S AUNT
25:36 - I don’t think we’re going to get answers. - ?
VO - With no one to answer for his death, it seems justice for Katlego, and closure for his family, will be delayed.
BREATHER
VO – Days before this week’s court proceedings, the family began preparing for Katlego’s funeral. First, though, they had to identify his body.
MOJABENG RALILATENG – KATLEGO'S AUNT
34:44 - What I saw was terrible. The body didn't look anything like the Katlego I knew. They are cruel people. What they did was absolutely cruel.



BREATHER – to let emotions linger, dip to black then to link
LINK - I’m in Ipupeng township just outside of Bloemfontein. This morning Dr Nandipha Magudumana appeared in court for her bail hearing. But here in Ipupeng, the mood is somber as Katlego Bereng's family prepare for his funeral. It hasn’t been easy for this family. And it feels a world’s apart from what we have seen in court.
BREATHER
KATLEGO'S GIRLFRIEND
08:14 - ... I never thought that Katlego would leave us.
KATLEGO MONYANE – KATLEGO'S COUSIN
13:39 - We lost a very talented person. We lost someone who had dreams, someone who wanted to become a better person in life, someone who was pushing. - 13:48
MOJABENG RALILATENG – KATLEGO'S AUNT
He had a bright future. We have lost an important person in our lives. We loved him so much.

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): Carte Blanche sits down with Judge Edwin Cameron to unpack the investigation that exposed the Thabo Bester saga. Also, nee details have emerged of the man whose body was used to fake Thabo Bester’s
metadata.Unique Selling Point: The audacious Thabo Bester prison break, the mystery of the unidentified body in cell 35 and the watchdog with no teeth – as they are uncovered, the details of the recent escape from Mangaung prison continue to shock the public both locally and internationally. For authorities, the focus has been on rounding up all the suspects and figuring out who had what role in the grand plan. And the biggest question in that regard remains: who did the charred remains wheeled out of cell 35 belong to? What seems to have escaped the spotlight is the fact that before the GroundUp exposé, there was an investigation by an independent body that was instrumental in piecing the bizarre facts together. Despite having almost limitless investigating powers, unfortunately this state organ has no authority to lay charges with law enforcement and initiate criminal investigations. It's core functions are to “facilitate the inspection of correctional centres” and “report on the treatment of inmates in correctional centres and on the treatment of inmates in correctional services.” Such reports are then sent to the Minister of Justice, Correctional Services and the portfolio committee. This body, tasked with overseeing these investigations, is the Judicial Inspectorate of Correctional Services (JICS), headed by Inspecting Judge Edwin Cameron. At the parliamentary portfolio committee recently, he was at pains to explain the limits to the powers of JICS.
metadata.Summary: The benefit of the previous insert is that some of our speakers, including the hidden inmate, speak extensively and passionately about the issues at Mangaung prison. Those previously unheard parts of the interview are hugely informative. With the judge and DCS brought into the conversation the story is a great opportunity to explore the future possibilities when it comes to the DCS-G4S contract. The question here being: if the department failed to listen and act on the repetitive warnings of JICS, how can the public trust that the department will act accordingly and in its best interests when it comes to the G4S contract? The department has said that it is in talks with its legal department about the contract. We expect the department to take the viewers into its confidence and give the status of thos talks.
